_doc: Measurement PROFILE — crypto majors. A reusable per-asset-class set of DEFAULTS for the surface fields of a sealed MC-* MeasurementContract instance. This is NOT a contract instance and NOT an admissibility seal: it carries no experiment_id and grants no economic admissibility, which only E-MT-00 PASS + E-MT-01 COMPLETE can grant (see MEASUREMENT_CONTRACT.md section 2, E4). Charter: docs/governance/MEASUREMENT_CONTRACT.md section 9.

subordinate_to.relationship: Profiles supply reusable per-asset-class DEFAULTS that a sealed MC-* instance inherits. Every enumerated value below is drawn from the frozen schema's own enums so that subordination is mechanically checkable. A profile never overrides the charter, never relaxes the E0-E4 bar, and never sets trust_status. OVERRIDE PRECEDENCE (2026-08-06, engine_gate discussion): an MC-* instance ALWAYS WINS on any field the frozen schema scopes per-experiment rather than per-asset-class -- concretely pipeline_identity.engine_gate_mode, pipeline_identity.dataset_integrity_level, splits.*, and metrics.multiplicity/control-protocol. This profile's surface_defaults for those fields are non-binding suggestions only, retained for convenience; the sealed instance's own declared value is authoritative. This was made explicit after F-058 showed gate mode is pipeline IDENTITY (which object was measured), not an asset-class property -- a profile default must never be mistaken for that identity.

profile.rationale: The historical primary laboratory (BNB-heavy forensics). A separate profile because cost scale and clock semantics differ materially from FX and MT5-sourced metals — the F-035 lesson that a shared cost constant is not portable across asset classes.

population.note: unit_of_analysis and detection_vs_trade are pinned to prevent the F-022 population substitution by default rather than per experiment. n_declared_min mirrors the historical n<30 INSUFFICIENT floor (F-030).

features.normalization_note: F-061 default. The corrected arm (FM-030/031) is reachable only via a non-promoted shadow config and is NOT this profile's basis.
features.session_note: F-066 is scope-bounded: Binance corpora are UNAFFECTED by the broker-clock mislabel, so the two bases coincide here. Declared rather than left implicit.
features.point_in_time_note: REQUIRES_DECISION. F-051: the centered-swing production binding is non-PIT and contaminates 10 canonical dims. No profile may claim causal validity until this states which builder produces PIT-clean features.

labels.note: ONE label definition across all profiles — this surface MUST NOT vary by asset class or cross-class generalization claims (F-035) become uninterpretable. Closes the F-022 class; re-derivation has already flipped conclusions twice (F-041B on zones, F-045 to F-059 on RR).

components.name: round_trip
components.bps_or_formula: DERIVED: k * median(bar_range_pct) computed per instrument from its own M15 corpus; k pending calibration

costs.legacy_note: The historical gate used a flat 12bps everywhere. F-025/F-035 show this is cost-dominant where the bar is smaller than the cost. Retained as provenance only, never as the model.

exits.intrabar_note: REQUIRES_DECISION. The SL-before-TP priority assumption must be stated explicitly; it is the difference between the optimistic close-only model and the governing intrabar model (F-025, and the exit-model adoption that reversed the BNB baseline).

splits.note: REQUIRES_DECISION. A 70/30 OOS split was used in at least one program (F-017) but was never contract-level, so cross-program comparability is unestablished.

metrics.provenance: Inherited from the historical M4 gate as recorded in the CLAUDE.md truths index (2000 permutations per F-035; the n<30 floor per F-030; control names per F-028/F-032/F-033/F-042). Inherited UNVERIFIED — values to reproduce, not values re-checked.

pipeline_identity.engine_gate_note: REQUIRES_DECISION and the sharpest open conflict. F-037: the research spine ran gate-OFF via an untracked .env, user-classified INTENDED (CRT isolation). F-058: the code default is ON, so a scrubbed or CI environment produced a DIFFERENT ledger under the same label. Must be DECLARED; may never be read from the environment.
pipeline_identity.dataset_integrity_note: REQUIRES_DECISION. F-039: the L3 pre-flight runs at only two call sites, both in backtest_v2; the entire src/research pipeline streams with the inline L1/L2 backstop only.
